name: Sakaguchi Daikichi
source:
Sakaguchi is a crime investigation advisor for the Central Police Department. He's an old-school detective who is not fond of the Heinous Crimes Unit. He takes the lead on the 'Yukimura Zaibatsu' case. 

[Spoiler]After the destruction of Snow Tower, Central's reputation was ruined. Sakaguchi took full responsibility to save his subordinates' jobs and went to another unknown assignment 'out in the sticks.'[/spoiler]
